testimonials.name: Srujan Gawande
testimonials.quote: Best Solution built me from scratch. The Sunday tests and mentor calls literally shaped my JEE journey.

testimonials.name: Samarth Khandelwal
testimonials.quote: Pinnacle program is intense but honest. 22 of 36 students crossed 95%ile — I was one of them.

testimonials.name: Anita Kulkarni
testimonials.quote: Biology diagrams and NCERT drills every single day. That's why I could crack NEET in first attempt.

testimonials.name: Rohan Yadav
testimonials.quote: The reasoning drills are honestly next level. I started weak and ended up NTSE stage-2.

testimonials.name: Priya Mehta
testimonials.quote: The CCG program helped me realise I want commerce, not medical. Career counselling is gold here.

testimonials.name: Vikram Singh
testimonials.quote: Their Olympiad batch made complex problems feel like puzzles. Kavya ma'am is legendary.

testimonials.name: Sneha Tiwari
testimonials.quote: Small batch, personal attention, weekly tests. Board prep was almost stress-free.

testimonials.name: Aditya Bhardwaj
testimonials.quote: The rank booster mocks were exactly the difficulty of JEE Advanced. Nothing was a surprise on exam day.
